message:
0.4.16: fix review findings and UI/UX polish

Logic
- Re-apply desktop dimming on resume (was racy after returning from nav apps)
- Night map: offline failures no longer disable the dark style for the session;
  retry/day-night switch/network recovery reset it and auto-retry
- Backup whitelist built from AccentTheme/VisualStyle enums
- manual_override is never exported and is cleared on import
- Dim slider saves on release; import preview computed off the main thread
- About test reads the real versionName

UI/UX
- Map toolbar: one row (open nav, home/work, More); zoom/recenter float on the map
- Bigger playback targets (64/56 dp, 48 dp on short screens)
- Drop occluded home background art; keep clock artwork
- Spider-Man night palette mid grey-blue (still light, ~25% dimmer cards)
- "Lyrics" button text, slim progress track without stop dot (tap to adjust when parked)
- Dashed empty shortcut tiles; generic icon instead of grey block
- Hide status chips while driving; one-line tappable location permission prompt
- All apps: no package names, larger labels, search (parked), recent apps
- About: last three versions in plain language, older collapsed; settings ordered by use
- Orange speed warning; TypeScale constants and min 14 sp notes on home

Tests: new unit (AppUsagePolicy, backup enums/override) and UI tests
(more tools, location prompt, app search); updated toolbar/background expectations.
